entry_state: Normal capacity limits fixed overhead carried by stock;idle output expenses the full180. Cash reconciliation must consistently separate depreciation from cash-cost inventory. Restoration distinguishes unwind,estimate changes,asset policy and settlement. Assurance is measured over the admitted population,with reimbursement separate. The mixed amendment catches up construction revenue by6 while allocating remaining inspection consideration prospectively. Billing now has its own clock:advance30,earned55 and invoice80 credited30 leave receivable50 and liability25;collection changes receivables without earning revenue. This billing explanation continues next.
exit_state: Billing preserves revenue while advances,invoices,credits and collections change distinct balances. Production uses component-specific equivalent units,admitted joint-cost allocation and separately measured supplier finance. Uncertain tax keeps current/deferred bases consistent and does not weight by avoiding examination. Inspection replacement removes the old component;lease termination separates surrendered rights from remaining-liability remeasurement. Benefits are remeasured before curtailment/settlement,with ceiling changes in OCI and a reset interest basis. Missing multi-employer information does not erase benefit exposure. Opening WIP now adds150 prior cost and unfinished conversion to the next production case.

findings.observation: Contract cash/receivable/net-position identity is derived by cancellation and illustrated through completion and full prepayment. WIP and uncertain-tax cases retain supplied policy/fact boundaries. The Version3.46 tax opening now explains uncertainty's current/deferred measurement consequences without the old project-history introduction.

Inspection and lease cases distinguish removal from replacement/remeasurement. Benefit ordering produces different profit and OCI even where net equity agrees. The incomplete multi-employer-information route retains deficit agreements and exposure rather than treating unavailable information as economic absence.
